definitions.set_A: every type configured in a fork config (phase0..fulu)
definitions.set_B: named types reached from the fulu.yaml roots through fields; a delegated field is followed into its type's own IR
definitions.set_I: inventory set: generated types in the closure of A (A is closed under fields only through I; B is a subset because the fulu.yaml roots are in A)
definitions.fulu_reachable: strict sense: B. The classification covers I and marks in_B per type
definitions.hand_written_delegate: a named type in the field closure of A with SSZ methods that no config generates (its methods are hand-written Go)
definitions.inline_depth: list/vector levels the type's own code walks; bytesN and delegated fields count 0
definitions.scope_in: not progressive, no union, inline depth <= 1, every field one of: uint8..64, bool, bytesN, bitvector, bitlist (ValidateBitlist contract), vector/list of a basic, bytesN or delegated container, list[byte], list[uint64], delegated container or delegated hand-written type
definitions.preset: mainnet is primary; minimal differences are listed separately

not_fulu.reason: not a fork config and no type reached from the Fulu roots
